author: GamingBolt
description:
With Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced right around the corner, our eagerness to get back to the Caribbean with Edward Kenway at our sides is through the roof. 

It made us think about how the game’s new changes make it a great way to take the franchise back to a time when it was fun, and improve on the experience that the original Black Flag gave us. 

Some interesting comparisons came up from those musings, and this one’s all about how Resynced could chart a course into the future for the franchise, by taking it back to a past where it stood tall as a very strong presence in stealth-action and open-world games. Join us as we take you through why we think that’s the case.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Is Bringing Back the Kind of Exploration AC Has Been Missing

author: GamingBolt
description:
EA Sports College Football 27’s most meaningful iteration is authenticity. This year’s entry doubles down on gameplay depth, line control, natural decision making, and more, all focused through the unique pageantry and intensity of college football. 

From overhauled defensive systems, to expanded playbooks and clearer career trajectories, here are fifteen things you should know before you buy.
title: EA Sports College Football 27 - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy
